authorization: Owner requested existing-store alternatives and then fixes for the top five estimated-coverage groups. No new retailer or production activation.
scope: 192 explicit successor variants. Historical originals, other ingredients, servings and safety checks retained. Ingredient identities are distinct; no equivalence of flavour, texture, nutrition or yield asserted.

tamarindpasta.replacement: CHS tamarindkoncentrat 435 ml, measured as sold in ml
tamarindpasta.author_decisions: New mild seasoning dose: 5 ml per serving per tamarind-bearing component in the 32 recipe families, retained recipe water and sweetness. The extended mung-sprout dish has two separate components (onion side and gravy), each with its own 20 ml for four servings; its combined purchase demand is 40 ml. All existing sauce reduction, soup, marinade and batter steps remain. Strength and flavour require cooking validation; this is not a conversion of the previous paste grams.
sources: https://www.chuahahseng.com/product/น้ำมะขามเปียกเข้มข้น/
tamarindpasta.source_limit: Importer corroborates exact 435-ml product; exact-product retailer declaration supplies composition. Manufacturer's different packs illustrate sour soup, curry and noodle uses only. No density or dilution ratio is inferred. Other retailers' prices are never imported.

masa harina.replacement: P.A.N. precooked white maize flour, dry grams
masa harina.author_decisions: Retain dry flour and all filling quantities. Start water 85/100/375/540 ml for 55/65/250/360 g flour; adjust after resting to a coherent dough. Breakfast cakes are cooked unfilled, then opened and filled. Raised-rim cakes are at most 1 cm thick; folded pockets have at most 0.5-cm walls. Wrapped parcels retain steam cooking and readiness checks. Broth dumplings are smaller (eight per serving), gently simmered with a cut-open core check. None is represented as an unchanged nixtamalized recipe.
masa harina.source_limit: Manufacturer supports precooked maize dough, filled cakes/pockets and wrapped preparations. Manufacturer identifies bollos pelones as a use; the named Cookpad author's recipe demonstrates boiled P.A.N. dough. Those methods do not validate Smako's exact quantities, fillings or cooking times. Water amounts and pan-baked pocket method are authored adaptations, not package yields. Corn starch is unsuitable as the main dough flour.

pärlkorn.replacement: Frebaco Kornris, lightly polished barley, dry grams
pärlkorn.author_decisions: Retain dry grain quantities; boil separately in ample water for 13–15 minutes and drain. Side dishes retain their oil after draining. For integrated stews/fillings, fold pre-cooked grain into the finished base. Preserve chicken simmer times and temperature checks. Tomato/mushroom bases use an authored 250-ml initial water amount and reduction checks; the chicken broth retains its liquid. No cooked yield is invented.
pärlkorn.source_limit: Supplier declares exact 1-kg product and 13–15-minute drained cooking method. Recipe-specific water and combinations are authored, not a verified absorption factor.

citrongräs.replacement: Whole fresh stalks, as-sold gross input of 50 g for four servings
citrongräs.author_decisions: Weigh before trimming, remove hard outer layers/root/top and finely cut the tender core actually remaining. The successor has no target core mass. All nine families already use minced tender core. Gross purchase mass must not supply edible nutrition. Add three active preparation minutes.
citrongräs.source_limit: Extension sources support discarding tough parts and using the tender core. Published chicken recipe uses about 50 g whole stalks as flavouring, not a yield study. Smako's 50-g input and fine-core use are authored choices; they do not guarantee the original 20–30 g edible quantity or flavour.

klibbigt ris.replacement: Oishii Yamato round-grain sushi rice, dry grams
klibbigt ris.author_decisions: Keep dry rice grams; rinse, measure dry volume, cook by the product's equal-volume water instruction and rest. Remove the original four/six-hour soak and steaming; update steps, dependencies, times, equipment and display names. The new coconut rice and egg-coated rice cakes have a different texture. Other separately roasted ordinary rice is retained.
klibbigt ris.source_limit: Exact declaration says round-grain rice, equal volumes dry rice/water, about 15-minute cooking and rest. Ten-minute rest is an author estimate. No grams-per-cup or glutinous-rice identity is assumed.
